What was the personal saving rate for 2020 as a whole?
SELECT try_cast(replace(value, ',', '') AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataa WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020'
How many dissenting opinions does the archive hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinions WHERE type = '040dissent'
Which grids drew the most power from nuclear plants in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_nuclear AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent lawsuits were filed each year from 2011 to 2020?

SELECT substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which electric utilities had the most residential customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(customers AS double) AS residential_customers FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people living in Queens were born outside the United States?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36081' AND variable = 'B05002_E013'
Which organisations own the most U.S. patents of all time?

SELECT disambig_assignee_organization AS organisation, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated WHERE disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the CAS registry number of caffeine?
SELECT c1 AS cas_number FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c0 = '2519' AND c2 = 'CAS'
Which states had the largest current-dollar GDP in the first quarter of 2025?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y2025_q1 AS double) AS gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_sqgdp1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many approved drugs in ChEMBL are natural products?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 4 AND natural_product = 1
How have U.S. exports to Mexico changed year by year?
SELECT year, max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS exports FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cty_name = 'MEXICO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average size of a home loan made in California in 2023?
SELECT avg(try_cast(loan_amount AS double)) AS avg_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND state_code = 'CA' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1'
Which Medicaid managed care plans enrolled the most people in 2017?
Medicaid Managed Care Enrollment By Program And Plan

SELECT plan_name, state, try_cast(total_enrollment AS double) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_by_program_and_plan WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2017' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

How many companies in Florida are excluded from federal awards?
SELECT count(*) AS exclusions FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions WHERE state_province = 'FL' AND classification <> 'Individual'
What kinds of legal documents does the law collection hold most?
SELECT document_type, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility rate schedules come with net metering rules?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE dgrules = 'Net Metering'
What is the average measured lipophilicity in the lipophilicity benchmark?
How many Service Contract Act wage determinations are active today?
SELECT count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' AND is_active = 'Y'
Which ZIP codes in New York City complain to the FCC the most?
SELECT zip, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'NY' AND city = 'New York' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many BACE-1 inhibitors in the benchmark have a pIC50 above 8?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bace WHERE pic50 > 8
What were homes worth on average when buyers took out a mortgage in 2023?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(property_value AS double))) AS avg_property_value FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) = '1'
How many corrective action plans are on file with the audit clearinghouse?
Which judges are assigned the most dockets in the Southern District of New York?
SELECT assigned_to_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE court_id = 'nysd' AND assigned_to_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many substances has ChEMBL deposited in PubChem?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map WHERE c1 = 'ChEMBL'
Where in Texas are one-bedroom fair market rents lowest?
SELECT countyname, min(try_cast(fmr1 AS double)) AS one_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many molecules are in the 50-million sample of GDB-17?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb17_50000000
How did the price index for gasoline move between 2021 and 2022?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SETB01' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2021', '2022') ORDER BY year
Which reactors' operating licences run out soonest?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, operating_license_expires FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY try_cast(operating_license_expires AS date) ASC LIMIT 10

How many regulatory reviews did OIRA complete in each recent year?
SELECT substr(cast(date_completed AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which power plants in Pennsylvania emitted the most sulfur dioxide in 2010?
SELECT facility_name, sum(so2_mass_lbs) AS so2_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'PA' AND year(date) = 2010 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured banks reported a loss for 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS banks FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20231231' AND try_cast(netinc AS double) < 0
Which states have the most clinicians opted out of Medicare?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What hourly rate do Service Contract Act determinations set for janitors on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_sca_rates WHERE occupation_title LIKE 'Janitor%'
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most published patent applications?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

r: Department of Health and Human Services

In how many counties does the map show at least one substation?
SELECT count(DISTINCT countyfips) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations
Which states have the most statute sections in force?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'statute' AND act_status = 'in_force' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of adults in California are citizens?
SELECT round(100.0 * try_cast(cvap_est AS double) / try_cast(adu_est AS double), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE geoname = 'California' AND lntitle = 'Total'
Which outcome methods do PubChem bioassays use most often?
SELECT aid2activityoutcomemethod, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod WHERE aid2activityoutcomemethod IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many clinical trials are recruiting patients right now?
SELECT count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status = 'RECRUITING'
Which auto insurers wrote the most premiums in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) AS premiums_millions FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

What did Medicaid pay per prescription on average in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) / sum(try_cast(number_of_prescriptions AS double)), 2) AS avg_paid_per_prescription FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2023' AND state <> 'XX'
In which technology sectors are women most often among a patent's inventors?

SELECT first_wipo_sector_title AS sector, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(women_inventors AS double)) / sum(try_cast(inventors AS double)), 1) AS pct_women_inventors FROM govblock_patents.pv_annual WHERE cast(assignee_sequence AS varchar) = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people lived in Brooklyn and worked in Manhattan in 2019?

SELECT sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'ny' AND part = 'main' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36047' AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '36061'
Which states had the most units reporting to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug products in ChEMBL carry a black box warning?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE black_box_warning = 1
Which materials carry the strongest magnetization per formula unit?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units AS double) AS magnetization FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many home loans were made in New York State in 2012?
SELECT count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) = '2012' AND state_code = '36' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1'
Which New York load zones used the most power on average in 2023?

SELECT name, avg(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS average_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
